name: my-mcp-app
description: A starter template for building MCP Apps on deco, enabling interactive UIs powered by the Model Context Protocol through tools and HTML resources.

name: kc-mcp-server
description: An MCP server for Kvindo Cloud that lets AI clients list, inspect, create, update, and delete cloud resources (VMs, volumes, Kubernetes, etc.) via natural language. Read-only by default, with write/delete operations gated by explicit opt-in environment variables.

name: contractmesh
description: ContractMesh is an MCP server that provides a trust-aware engineering knowledge layer, enabling agents to retrieve confirmed decisions, constraints, and known risks with provenance. It grounds AI changes in explicit engineering knowledge rather than inference alone.

name: NIOS WAPI MCP Read Gateway
description: Read-only MCP server for Infoblox NIOS grids, enabling IPAM, DNS, DHCP, and grid health queries via WAPI with multi-grid support.

name: is-it-agent-ready
description: Provides agent-readiness audits of public websites via Cloudflare's scanner, enabling users to run scans, save reports, and enforce safety boundaries from natural language.

name: employee-graph-mcp
description: An MCP server that provides tools to query and analyze an employee knowledge graph in Neo4j, including semantic resume search, person similarity, and read-only Cypher queries.

name: KriteriusMX
description: Enables Claude to search and retrieve legal sources from Mexican and inter-American courts (SCJN, TFJA, DOF, Corte IDH) with complete citations and official links.

name: dutch-supermarkets-mcp
description: MCP server for Dutch supermarkets and drugstores, enabling product search, price comparison, promotions, shopping lists, meal planning, price alerts, and budget tracking via natural language.

name: vaultwarden-mcp
description: MCP server for accessing Vaultwarden servers with multi-account support.

name: signal-mcpl
description: MCPL server that bridges Signal via signal-cli, exposing DMs and group chats as channels and providing signal_send and signal_react tools.

name: esim-mcp
description: An MCP server for searching and comparing travel eSIM data plans by country, planning multi-country trips, and optionally checking eSIM usage with an API token.

name: mcp-server-starter
description: This MCP server starter template enables developers to quickly build production-ready MCP servers with Streamable HTTP, stateless design, and OAuth 2.1 authorization. It provides a structured, capability-based architecture with Postgres audit logging and centralized scope enforcement.

name: bsky-mcp
description: Remote MCP server giving Claude-family agents credential-isolated access to Bluesky/ATProto via a self-hosted PDS, with read triage, search, and write tools (posts, replies, likes, reposts, follows) governed by policy ceilings and consent.

name: 2dai-mcp-server
description: MCP server for 2DAI that enables AI assistants to generate images and videos, upload references, browse the public feed, and manage cloud drive on a 2DAI account.

name: evidiq-axiom-mcp
description: A credit bureau for AI agents that provides proof-backed reputation scoring, attestations, and credit reports. It offers 11 MCP tools for verifying interactions, recommending agents, and managing disputes.

name: AgentRoots
description: AgentRoots is an MCP server for agent continuity that preserves goals, findings, and evidence across sessions. It enables agents to propose, review, and reuse compact, evidence-backed state instead of replaying transcripts.

name: cmd-exec-mcp
description: A command execution MCP server supporting local execution, sandbox isolation via Docker/OpenSandbox, and SSH remote execution.

name: credential-broker-mcp
description: A local-first MCP server that lets AI agents use gated APIs without holding keys, enforcing declarative policies, injecting secrets server-side, and auditing access without content.

name: cairn
description: A local-first MCP server that connects Claude Code to your Robinhood account, enabling read-only portfolio insights, tax analysis, and natural language queries, with optional human-in-the-loop trading actions.

name: apple-suite-mcp
description: Secure, opt-in MCP connector for Apple apps (Calendar, Reminders, Contacts, Notes, and more) with modular permissions, human approval, and optional remote access.

name: hebbian-vault
description: MCP server for intelligent, use-adaptive Obsidian vault search, ranking files via BM25, PageRank, and Hebbian usage signals. Enables hybrid ranked search, neighboring-note discovery, and vault analytics.

name: io.github.ermintoygar/vault-health-mcp
description: MCP server for Obsidian vault structural health checks, enabling users to find broken wikilinks, orphaned notes, and missing frontmatter, with auto-repair capabilities.

name: mcp-knowledge-gaps
description: Identifies knowledge gaps in markdown vaults, ranks them by priority, generates research questions, and offers long-tail sampling to break confirmation bias.

name: mcp-curiosity-engine
description: Surfaces forgotten notes from markdown vaults using wikilink graph structure and file mtime to identify dormant notes, then generates cross-domain bridge queries for serendipitous rediscovery.

name: mcp-contradiction-check
description: Detects contradictions in markdown vaults by finding note pairs with high concept overlap but conflicting quantitative or negation claims. Helps prevent knowledge corruption by surfacing disputes before they propagate.

name: France Data MCP
description: Provides AI agents with access to French public registries including company records, property sale prices, housing energy performance, and short-term rental rates via MCP tools.

name: MCP Tool-Retrieval Gateway
description: An MCP proxy that embeds tool definitions and returns only the top-k semantically relevant tools per query, reducing context usage and routing calls to upstream MCP servers.

name: postgres-mcp-server
description: A read-only MCP server for querying PostgreSQL databases. It exposes a tool that runs SELECT queries and returns results to the agent.

name: MCP Ticket Server
description: Exposes a ticket classification tool that categorizes support tickets by severity, category, sentiment, and summary via MCP, using the Anthropic API for classification and packaged as a Claude Desktop extension.

name: USRCP
description: Local-first MCP server providing a shared, AES-256-GCM encrypted SQLite ledger of structured user state (stack, projects, preferences) that any MCP-aware tool can read/write, with user-held keys and optional zero-knowledge sync.

name: AgentGuard MCP Server
description: Provides a secure MCP boundary for AI agents, intercepting and validating tool calls, redacting secrets, and requiring human approval for sensitive actions with a tamper-evident audit trail.

name: lime-ref-postgres-mcp
description: MCP server that provides secure PostgreSQL access with LIME agent identity verification, whitelist-based authorization, and audit events.

name: @clikta/mcp-server
description: Enables Claude to drive a real browser and automatically turn interactions into Clikta interactive demos, step-by-step guides, and narrated videos.

name: GDG Store MCP Server
description: MCP server for the fictional GDG Store, providing tools, resources, and prompts to interact with the store's REST API and enable AI assistants to access product data.
